## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fó shuō fǎ-yìn jīng* is a single-fascicle Northern-Sòng translation of the Dharma-seals discourse, a parallel of [T103](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0103) (Dharmarakṣa). The Chinese title 法印 ("Dharma-seal") is the standard term that displaced the older 聖法印.

**Abstract**

T104 is one of Shīhù's series of Sòng-Institute renderings; the defensible bracket 982–1017 is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
